metadata.subtitle: Fugue XXI in B-flat major, twenty-two voices: Capriccio sopra la lontananza
metadata.composer: Claude / Sam, after J. S. Bach (BWV 992)
metadata.instrument: Twenty-two voices (open score): the first twenty-two partials of B-flat
metadata.credits: J. S. Bach, Capriccio sopra la lontananza del suo fratello dilettissimo BWV 992: the fugue subject, answer and countersubject (Fuga all'imitazione della cornetta di postiglione), the Aria di postiglione (run and octave call), the opening turn of the Arioso, the descending chromatic tetrachord of the Lamento. Verified against the Bach-Gesellschaft edition, vol. 36 (1890), pp. 190-196.
